verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a headless CLI and official Docker images for running collections in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions. Those runs are one-off executions, though; the background triggering and any recurring schedule come from the host CI platform, not from Bruno. The evidence shows no native scheduler, monitor, or autonomous background agent within Bruno itself, so the CLI is only an adjacent building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
